comparison.objective: Start a loose nail at a mark and hammer it flush.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual nail stabilization, impact control, hand withdrawal, and repeated hammering.
comparison.success_condition: Nail flush, upright and on-mark; no bent nail or struck gripper; hammer released and 1 s stillness.
comparison.reason: Impact-driven fastening is meaningfully different from controlled granular flow and selective retention.
